control.ripple_counter_proof: Each counter toggles, publishes only q=0 and divides event count by two. The 216 input events plus a second path for 40 of them give 256. Every input has positive weight, so missing any input prevents the 256th event. Eight stages emit once and all reset to zero.
control.counter_anchoring: Bottom counter: J0 followed by J of every input copy, then K(self)K(padding); padding is initialized 1 and computes only 1, so result is NOT old q. Upper counter: K(source)K(source)K1; source latest-q cancels without assuming the published zero is still current.
control.first_phase_proof: Completion counter publishes zero only after all 256 arrivals are consumed. No next frame is allowed during calculation, so it stays zero until the first phase runs; K(completion)K1 toggles that phase.
control.protocol_precondition: Every Xi exactly once per frame, arbitrary partition/order, and no next frame until both queues drain.

old_feedback_512.reason: Multiple-node feedback, Xi references outside input copies, suffix IDs, constant bootstrap and old snapshot/queue format are not V4 designs.

input_barrier.tradeoff: Padded counting saves nodes but uses more operations and requires exactly one event per input per frame.

unproven.whole_network: Not exhaustively searched; no claim of globally fewest nodes or minimum runtime operations.
